user_ruling.question: 交叉引用对话框列不出图/表题注，是否按模板为准修复
user_ruling.conflict_resolved: AGENTS.md 决策 3 字面写「SEQ Table 和 SEQ Figure 分开编号」，模板用的是 SEQ 表 / SEQ 图；按「模板是格式值的唯一事实源」以模板为准，决策 3 已随本包改写

defect_evidence.user_report: 转换后的文档插入交叉引用时，引用类型选 图 或 表，引用编号项列表为空
defect_evidence.three_way: 模板与源文档的题注是复杂域 SEQ 表 / SEQ 图，标签 run 紧接 fldChar begin；修复前输出是简单域 w:fldSimple，标签 run 带尾随空格，标识符为 SEQ Table / SEQ Figure
root_cause: scripts/wxdf/rendering.py hardcoded _CAPTION_SEQUENCE = {"table": ("表 ", "Table"), "figure": ("图 ", "Figure")} and wrote a simple field (w:fldSimple)
scripts/wxdf/template.py hardcoded captions.table_sequence / figure_sequence as English and never read the template
Word matches the cross-reference item list by SEQ identifier, so the Chinese 图/表 labels matched no item
defect_evidence.not_affected: formula numbering keeps its identifier because the source SEQ 公式 field is a retained inline atom (decision 9): 3 to 3

tasks.subject: 题注序列标识符与域形态改为模板拥有

proof.red: tests/test_modular_caption_sequence.py 6 failed, 1 passed before the change
proof.real_document: 技术文件格式及书写要求.docx: SEQ 表 1, SEQ 图 3, SEQ 公式 3, no SEQ Table / SEQ Figure, matching the source and the template; status completed_with_warnings with only the pre-existing source_heading_level_normalized advisory, saved_output_audit passed, unexpected_styles empty
proof.template_self: the template converted with itself keeps its status and audits; the SEQ counts move from 表 0 / 图 0 to 表 1 / 图 3 with 公式 3 unchanged
proof.review_counterexamples: a 图 caption followed by a table no longer poisons table_sequence; a template without a caption style reads no field from unstyled paragraphs

invariants: every rebuilt caption uses the identifier the template uses for its kind
no SEQ identifier the template does not use appears in the output
caption visible text equals the saved paragraph text, so the readback text comparison still holds
formula numbering fields are copied by reference, count unchanged
an appendix caption that preserves its source number gains no field (decision 7)
three audits passed, unexpected_styles empty, risk_warnings empty for ordinary documents

axis_standards: F1 fixed (latent): an unresolved caption style left style_id None, which matched every unstyled paragraph and read its field; the loader now falls back without scanning
F2 fixed (latent): the neighbouring-block checks outranked the label, so a 图 caption followed by a table poisoned table_sequence; the label now decides and the neighbours are the fallback

F4 fixed: the SEQ identifier read and the identifier-to-kind vocabulary had two copies; both converged into scripts/text_utils.py (sequence_identifier, CAPTION_SEQUENCE_KINDS, CAPTION_SEQUENCE_FALLBACK)
F5 fixed: the spec listed tests/test_md_captions.py as a consumer to update, while that test drives the legacy chain and stays correct; the spec now says it is unchanged
no stable interface renamed; no em dash and no banned construction in the added Chinese prose
axis_spec: F3 fixed: the spec and two docstrings overstated the neighbouring-block rule; the template's own 图1 caption is decided by its label (the image sits two note paragraphs earlier), so the spec, T01 and both docstrings now state label-first with the neighbours as fallback

F6 fixed: the spec's eight test items had only seven tests; a benchmark baseline test and a formula-field test were added (11 tests now), and the real-document statistics are recorded as evidence because that file lives outside the repo

F7 recorded, not fixed: a caption carrying an opaque_inline atom with a cached_result can drift from the saved paragraph text; reproduced with a simple-field fixture and confirmed identical on HEAD (git stash of scripts/), so it is pre-existing and out of scope
review.counterexamples: figure caption above a table, template without a caption style, table caption below its table, simple-field template, repeated captions, authored 图3-1 number, appendix caption, caption in a table cell, unsupported caption_type: all behave as designed; no assertion was weakened

residuals: the legacy diagnostic writers (scripts/docx_render.py, scripts/word_model_renderer.py) keep the English identifiers and the simple field, and are out of scope
the Word/WPS cross-reference caption dialog cannot be verified on this machine; it is an external manual gate

the caption label is taken from the identifier (a Chinese Word caption label and its sequence identifier are the same text, which the template shows); a template whose label differs from its identifier is not covered
the cached number is always written as 1 and Word recomputes it when the fields refresh

PRE-EXISTING (found while implementing, confirmed on HEAD): a source paragraph carrying w:fldSimple makes the readback text comparison report paragraph_order_changed, because python-docx's paragraph.text skips simple-field content while the audit walks every w:t

note: Uncommitted: scripts/wxdf/template.py, scripts/wxdf/rendering.py, scripts/caption_placement.py, scripts/text_utils.py, AGENTS.md, tests/test_modular_caption_sequence.py, five updated test files, docs/execution-v8/. Version 0.14.3 is the current candidate.
